# YourBasic

> YourBasic is a comprehensive educational resource covering algorithms, data structures, complexity analysis, and Go programming with clear explanations and practical code examples.

Created by Stefan Nilsson, YourBasic provides in-depth tutorials and reference materials for programmers learning computer science fundamentals and the Go programming language. The site emphasizes practical understanding through step-by-step examples and best practices.

## Key Topics

- Go programming
- Algorithms
- Data structures
- Time complexity
- Big O notation
- Dynamic programming
- Concurrent programming
- Graph algorithms
- Loop invariants
- API design
- Language comparison
- String handling
- Maps and hash tables
- Functional programming
- Algorithm analysis

## Go Programming Guides

- [Go go-to guide](https://yourbasic.org/golang): Comprehensive Go programming tutorials and code examples for all levels
- [Concurrent programming](https://yourbasic.org/golang/concurrent-programming): Tutorial on Go concurrency: goroutines, channels, deadlock, and synchronization
- [Do you make these Go coding mistakes?](https://yourbasic.org/golang/gotcha): 27 Go gotchas and pitfalls guide to help identify and fix common mistakes
- [Why Go? – Key advantages you may have overlooked](https://yourbasic.org/golang/advantages-over-java-python): Comprehensive comparison of Go advantages over Java and Python
- [Java to Go in-depth tutorial](https://yourbasic.org/golang/go-java-tutorial): In-depth guide for Java programmers learning Go with syntax comparisons
- [Go string handling overview [cheat sheet]](https://yourbasic.org/golang/string-functions-reference-cheat-sheet): Cheat sheet of 40+ essential Go string functions and UTF-8 operations
- [Maps explained: create, add, get, delete](https://yourbasic.org/golang/maps-explained): Tutorial on Go maps: hash table implementation and key operations
- [Functional programming in Go [case study]](https://yourbasic.org/golang/your-basic-func): Case study of functional graph implementation using immutable data types

## Algorithms & Complexity Analysis

- [Algorithms explained](https://yourbasic.org/algorithms): Introduction to algorithms, data structures and analysis with code examples
- [Big O notation: definition and examples](https://yourbasic.org/algorithms/big-o-notation-explained): Explanation of Big O, Big Omega, and Theta notation for complexity analysis
- [How to analyze time complexity: Count your steps](https://yourbasic.org/algorithms/time-complexity-explained): Guide to analyzing time complexity using Big O notation and step counting
- [Dynamic programming [step-by-step example]](https://yourbasic.org/algorithms/dynamic-programming-explained): Step-by-step guide to dynamic programming with memoization and tabulation
- [Loop invariants can give you coding superpowers](https://yourbasic.org/algorithms/loop-invariants-explained): Tutorial on using loop invariants for algorithm design and code verification

## Design & Best Practices

- [API design: principles and best practices](https://yourbasic.org/algorithms/your-basic-api): Best practices for API design including documentation, versioning, and interfaces

## Optional Resources

- [About YourBasic](https://yourbasic.org/about): Stefan Nilsson's site about coding, algorithms, data structures and Go
- [Top programming languages in use 2000-2020 [informal study]](https://yourbasic.org/top-programming-languages): Analysis of top programming languages in tech job listings from 2000-2020
